name: ByteDefense
author: ByteDefense

sections.description:
ByteDefense Scanner is your ultimate WordPress security companion, designed to safeguard your website from malicious threats, vulnerabilities, and potential exploits. Whether you’re running a blog, an e-commerce store, or a business site, this plugin offers a robust scanning solution that identifies risks in both your site’s files and database, providing peace of mind—all within a sleek, intuitive interface.

Why Choose ByteDefense Scanner?

  • Fast & Thorough File Scanning: Detects malware, suspicious files, and security loopholes in as little as a few minutes (up to 15 minutes for larger sites).
  • Database Security Scanning: Scans your WordPress database (posts, meta, and options) for inserted malicious links, injected JavaScript, hidden content, iframes, and other suspicious patterns.
  • User-Friendly Dashboard: Easily navigate through the “Scan & Report,” “Database Scan,” and “Support” tabs—no technical expertise required!
  • Real-Time Feedback: Watch the scanning process with a beautiful AJAX loader, ensuring you know exactly when your site is being checked.
  • High Performance: Built with WordPress best practices, ensuring minimal impact on your site’s speed and resources.
  • Future-Ready: Designed by ByteDefense Team, this plugin is poised for continuous updates and cutting-edge security features.

Imagine a tool that not only protects your site but also empowers you with actionable insights. ByteDefense Scanner doesn’t just stop at scanning—it’s a gateway to a safer, stronger WordPress experience. With cyber threats on the rise, this plugin is your first line of defense, offering enterprise-level security at the fingertips of every WordPress user.

Key Features

  • One-Click File Scanning: Simply press the “Scan” button to initiate a deep analysis of your site’s files.
  • Database Scanning: Scan your WordPress database for malicious links, injected scripts, hidden content, iframes, and other threats with a single click.
  • Customizable Settings: Tailor the plugin to your needs (settings tab coming soon with more options!).
  • Dedicated Support: Access help directly from the plugin interface—because your security matters.
  • AJAX-Powered Interface: Smooth, modern design with real-time updates during scans.
  • Translation-Ready: Built with localization in mind, making it accessible to users worldwide.

The Power of Prevention

Cyberattacks can cost you traffic, revenue, and reputation. ByteDefense Scanner helps you stay ahead of the curve by identifying issues before they become problems. Whether it’s a hidden backdoor in your files, outdated code, or malicious content injected into your database, this plugin has you covered. Don’t wait for a breach—act now and secure your WordPress site with a tool trusted by thousands (and growing!).

Built for Everyone

From beginners to developers, ByteDefense Scanner balances simplicity with power. Its clean design and clear instructions make it accessible, while its extensible framework allows advanced users to customize the scanning process.

Download ByteDefense Scanner today and join a community dedicated to WordPress security excellence. Your website deserves the best—give it the protection it needs!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the bytedefense-scanner folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the “ByteDefense” menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Click “Scan & Report” to scan your site’s files, or “Database Scan” to check your WordPress database for threats.
sections.faq:
What does ByteDefense Scanner do?

ByteDefense Scanner scans your WordPress site’s files and database for malware, vulnerabilities, and suspicious activity. It checks for malicious links, injected scripts, hidden content, and other threats, ensuring your website stays safe and secure.

How long does a scan take?

For most sites, file scanning takes just a few minutes, while larger sites may take up to 15 minutes. Database scanning typically completes in a few minutes, depending on the size of your database. You’ll see a beautiful loading animation while it works its magic!

Do I need technical skills to use this plugin?

Not at all! ByteDefense Scanner is designed with simplicity in mind. Just click “Scan” or “Scan Database,” and let it do the heavy lifting.

Is it safe to run the scanner on my live site?

Yes! The plugin is built with WordPress best practices and runs efficiently without disrupting your site’s performance. It’s lightweight and secure.

What happens after a scan?

Once the scan completes, the page refreshes, and you’ll see the results (future updates will include detailed reports). For now, it confirms the scan is done with a “SCAN_DONE” or “DATABASE_SCAN_DONE” message.

Is support available if I run into issues?

Yes! Head to the “Support” tab in the plugin interface for assistance. ByteDefense Team is committed to helping you secure your site.

Will this slow down my website?

No. ByteDefense Scanner is optimized for performance and only runs when you initiate a scan, ensuring zero impact on your visitors.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, the base version is free! Future premium features may be added, but the core file and database scanning functionality is yours at no cost.
